title: Incoming inspection triage
description: Check one sampled dimension against the active drawing. Measure correct acceptances, false acceptances and cases needing quality review.
system: Triage the single sampled dimension in this synthetic incoming inspection. Return one JSON object with part_id, lot_id, revision, lower_mm, upper_mm, measured_mm, spec_evidence, reading_evidence, finding and routing. Use the active drawing revision and express its limits and the reading as decimal strings in mm. In spec_evidence quote the complete drawing specification line for that revision. In reading_evidence quote the complete line beginning Reading:. Apply the supplied decision_rule. When no rule is available, use finding insufficient_evidence and routing review. Under an applicable rule, use finding within_limits and routing accept if the sampled dimension qualifies, otherwise use finding outside_limits and routing review. The decision concerns this recorded sample only.
